sentences.text: This original petition has been filed challenging the order of interim maintenance passed by the Family Court, Aluva in Crl.M.P.No. 144 of 2024 in M.C.No. 29 of 2024.
2. The petitioner is the husband of the respondent No.1 and father of the respondent No.2.
The respondents filed a maintenance case against the petitioner.

The respondents also filed Crl.M.P.No.
144 of 2024, claiming interim maintenance at the rate of Rs.15,000/- and Rs.10,000/-, respectively.
The Family Court, after hearing both sides, granted interim maintenance at the rate of Rs.4,000/- to the respondent No.1 and Rs.2,000/- to the respondent No.2.
It is challenging the said order, this original petition has been preferred.
3. I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner.
4. The marriage and paternity are not in dispute.

The petitioner has no case that the respondent No.1 is employed ..3..
2025:KER:1704 and has any source of income.

The petitioner has raised a contention that the respondent No.1 left the house of the petitioner without any sufficient reason and therefore, she is not entitled to any maintenance as per Section 125 of Cr.P.C.
The definite case of the respondent No.1 is that, on account of the cruelty exercised by the petitioner, a crime was registered against the petitioner under Sections 498A and 323 of IPC.
Therefore, even if the respondent No.1 is residing away, there is justification for the same as rightly held by the Family Court.
The petitioner being the husband of the respondent No.1 and father of the respondent No.2 is legally and morally bound to maintain the respondents.
The petitioner has admitted that he is an Interior Designer.
He has produced Ext.B1 salary certificate, which shows that his net salary is Rs.12,000/-.
However, there is nothing on record to show his gross salary.
Considering the means of the petitioner and the requirement of the respondents, the interim maintenance amount granted by the Family Court appears to be reasonable.
I see no reason to interfere with the impugned order.
Accordingly, the original petition is dismissed.
